questions: Does the letter of intent (LOI) for a commercial shop lease have to be signed in front of a notary?

Does the letter of intent (LOI) for the commercial shop have to be signed in front of a notary? The LOI states that the parties will elevate the contract to a public deed before a notary if either party requests it.
Is it safe to take the new antibiotic with my blood thinner?
Context: The patient is on warfarin for atrial fibrillation with a target INR of 2 to 3 (last INR 2.6). The new antibiotic is clarithromycin 500 mg twice daily for 7 days.

Will home insurance cover a kitchen leak caused by a corroded joint under the sink that had been ongoing for several weeks, given that the policy covers escape of water except where caused by gradual deterioration or wear and tear, with an excess of 350?

Do I owe the employee for the extra hours they worked in the spring? The employment contract states that normal hours are 40 per week and that overtime is paid only when approved in advance by the shift manager. The timesheets for weeks 10 to 22 show 52, 49, 55, and 50 hours, and they were signed by the shift manager.
Can I keep working while I am on the new treatment?

Context: I am a harbour pilot diagnosed with Erdheim-Chester disease and am starting vemurafenib 480 mg twice daily. My pilotage authority requires pilots to report any new medication that may cause dizziness or visual disturbance before the next transfer.
Do I have to tell my employer about my medical diagnosis?

Can a self-employed individual claim the cost of hearing aids as a business expense? The individual is a self-employed church organist and piano tuner with a turnover of 31,480. The hearing aids cost 4,200 and were fitted due to bilateral otosclerosis.
Can a landlord keep a tenant's deposit? The tenancy agreement states the deposit is returnable less any lawful deductions. The tenant has given notice to end the tenancy.

The amount is 100, reduced to 60 if paid within 14 days. The sign at the entrance is partly covered by a hedge, and the 2-hour limit is printed in small text.

Does a former spouse get half of a defined benefit pension in a divorce? The individual has 22 years of service in the scheme, of which 9 years were during the marriage. The couple was married for 9 years (2013-2022), has two children, and the former spouse worked part-time.
Can I deduct my home office expenses? I work from home three days a week by choice, although an office desk is available at my workplace. My home office is 12 square metres of a 90 square metre flat.

Is a landlord allowed to enter a rental property without asking the tenant first?
